relationships.operation: Maintain balanced methionine-cycle flux so methionine availability, SAM-dependent methylation, homocysteine recycling and transsulfuration remain coordinated across changing physiological demand.

functional_dependency.statement: Glycine is the acceptor substrate of glycine N-methyltransferase, which consumes SAM and forms SAH and sarcosine during methyl-group handling.

dietary_supply.statement: Individual glycine composition in foods supports dietary supply of the same amino-acid substrate; no amount or increased flux is inferred.

targeted_searches.query: Glycine food composition, chemical form and preparation; distinguish tested formulation

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Endogenous glycine synthesis and other methyltransferases also contribute. Enzyme loss is not glycine deficiency; extra dietary glycine has not been established to normalise whole-cycle or brain methylation.

relationships.operation: Maintain epithelial tight junction integrity and selective permeability at the gut lining.

scientific_assessment.operation: Maintain epithelial tight junction integrity and selective permeability at the gut lining.

functional_dependency.statement: Glutamine availability sustains epithelial junction-related cellular capacity; cell perturbations distinguish this from systemic inflammation.

dietary_supply.statement: The existing randomised oral-glutamine trial establishes delivery of the same identified amino acid. Food composition and ordinary-food intervention equivalence remain unresolved.

targeted_searches.query: Glutamine food composition, chemical form and preparation; distinguish tested formulation
targeted_searches.outcome: Combined Glx and total-protein tables cannot establish glutamine-specific food composition. No unsupported food source is added.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Cell deprivation including endogenous-synthesis blockade is not ordinary human nutritional deficiency; culture exposure is not a food dose. Selected clinical population and supplemental free glutamine. Neither ordinary-food equivalence nor benefit in healthy people, brain function or ADHD is established.

relationships.biological_role: Enterocyte metabolic substrate supporting epithelial proliferation, repair, and tight-junction protein maintenance.
relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-23: previously Unset supply decision completed under the documented Capacity gate. Original atom and note are preserved in the immutable assessment baseline. Supplemental exposure is not ordinary-food efficacy.
relationships.limitation: Glutamine is supplied substantially from endogenous and systemic pools and becomes conditionally indispensable under stress; adult supplementation trials show no overall permeability benefit, so dietary protein or glutamine provision is not established as a general PM1 lever. A separate postinfectious IBS trial supports a selected supplementation response; this does not establish general need.
relationships.qualification: PM identity says missing; canonical registry now resolves. scientific_assessment.operation: Adjust community substrate-processing capacity through resource competition and changes in microbial function.

functional_dependency.statement: Inulin supplies beta-(2,1)-linked fructan substrate to microbes with the corresponding utilisation machinery, supporting this glycan-processing capacity.

dietary_supply.statement: Oral long-chain inulin is a tested dietary exposure. Primary plant chain-length measurements independently support qualitative inulin source research; vegetable consumption has not been shown equivalent to the purified intervention.

targeted_searches.query: Inulin food composition, chemical form and preparation; distinguish tested formulation
targeted_searches.outcome: Primary chain-length measurements support preparation-qualified chicory-root/Jerusalem-artichoke candidates. Generic fructan labels do not establish long-chain inulin.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Utilisation genes, chain length, alternative substrates and resident organisms constrain the response. A supplied inulin substrate is not an indispensable intake, a guaranteed abundance shift, butyrate yield, mucus effect or clinical benefit.

evidence.statement: Primary tuber profiling reported high-polymerisation inulin, including a DP-above-30 fraction; storage altered the chain-length distribution.

food_targets.limitations: Variety, maturity, storage and chain length limit generalisation. No cooked-food quantity, universal microbial response, butyrate yield or mucus benefit inferred.

relationships.operation: Maintain gut-to-brain nerve signalling through the vagus nerve and enteric nervous system.

scientific_assessment.operation: Maintain gut-to-brain nerve signalling through the vagus nerve and enteric nervous system.

mechanism_engagement.statement: Linoleic acid engages intestinal fatty-acid sensing and vagal/brainstem nutrient signalling in the tested mouse circuits.

dietary_exposure.statement: The identified fatty acid is present in verified food-composition records and reaches intestinal sensing through lipid digestion. The direct classification concerns the fatty-acid sensing input, not a downstream metabolite or a claim that ordinary meals reproduce the 10% experimental exposure.

targeted_searches.query: Linoleic acid food composition, chemical form and preparation; distinguish tested formulation
targeted_searches.outcome: Retrieve existing structured linoleic-acid edges; free fatty-acid stimulus differs from esterified fatty acids in foods.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: This is physiological nutrient sensing, not a beneficial direction or a need to increase linoleic acid.
